article.story: BUFFALO, N.Y. -- — Jake Lemelman had 29 points in Mercyhurst’s 78-75 victory over Albany (NY) on Sunday. Lemelman also contributed six rebounds for the Lakers (3-5). Cameron Johnson scored 14 points and added five rebounds and three blocks. Markus Maxwell-Grimes had 13 points and shot 5 for 7, including 3 for 5 from beyond the arc. Tyler Jones finished with 26 points and two steals for the Great Danes (4-4). Albany (NY) also got 11 points from Ollie Engen. Miles Rose also had 10 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
